text: player
Clearing the Ruins
Frieren introduces everyone, and we brief Stark and Fern on the situation so far and what we know about the island.
Fern
Master {var:player_nickname}, how did you know how to defeat that monster for good?
Because the patterns on its body formed a mahjong hand.
Once you complete a winning hand, the tiles collapse.
Stark
Mahjong...? A winning hand...?
Ichihime
That was Master's special move just now, nyaa!
Is that how magic works in your world?
You could say that, nyaa! Both mahjong and magic work miracles, nyaa!
If you want to learn, I can teach you, nyaa!
Learning mahjong seems essential for the journey ahead.
We'll be counting on you, Ms. Ichihime, Master {var:player_nickname}.
Fern and Stark officially join the party.
Exploring ruins, locating crystal balls, transmuting materials... and learning mahjong on the side.
Ichihime the Hero and her companions make steady progress across the island.
Frieren
This mana... It might be a grimoire.
No, there's definitely a valuable grimoire inside here. That's what my experience as a mage is telling me.
Ms. Ichihime, please help me reason with her... Ah!
After much effort, we manage to rescue Ichihime.
Now that we know these chests are fake, let's get moving.
No... That just means we have even more reason to open the rest.
{var:player_nickname}, did you know? Mikheit is only 99% accurate.
Historical discoveries have been made by great mages who recognized that remaining 1%... So it's worth another shot.
Exactly, nyaa! Probabilities can be deceptive, nyaa!
Just because mine was fake doesn't mean Frie's isn't the real deal, nyaa!
It's like getting away with a discard only to deal in on the exact same one next turn, nyaa! I know the feeling all too well, nyaa!
Why use such a jinxed example...?
Yes, she makes a good point. Here I go!
Wait!
Frieren, don't–
But it is already too late.
It's so dark and scary in here!
And so, the adventure of Ichihime the Hero and her companions continues.
Leia
Thank you all for your hard work these past few days.
Don't mention it. I'm just glad we could be of help.
And it hasn't been without its rewards.
Kaavi
Remarkable techniques long thought lost to the currents of fate have been unearthed on this island.
Yuzu
Argh, even the Red Panda Squad learned how to levitate scoring sticks when declaring Riichi and auto-swap tile backs every match!
If only we could make the tiles that aren't Dora sparkle like gems too, nyaa!
Speaking of which, I found something wonderful in the best-hidden chest... a spell that can create wind, blossoms, snow, and moonlight out of thin air!
Yes... Quite a worthwhile trip.
Wind, blossoms, snow, and moonlight...? What's that? Sounds pretty fancy...
We haven't had a chance to try it out, so no one knows what it actually does yet.
Let's ride this momentum and crush the final boss, nyaa!
This must be the deepest part of the ruins.
Argh? Did you hear that? It sounds like voices...
Yes, whispers of fate echo here, but they are too jumbled to decipher.
Our target lies among them.
That's like fishing out the single winning tile left in the wall, nyaa... Way too hard, nyaa!
Spot-on analogy.
Anything can happen on this island. It wouldn't surprise me if a tile actually spoke up.
So the sound is coming from a mahjong tile? In that case, that spell I found earlier in the ruins might help...
N-no! It was just a figure of speech!
<color=#6CC2B6>Spell to find the extraordinary mahjong tile!</color>
No way... You can't seriously find a mahjong tile with special powers...
A giant mahjong tile appears suspended in midair, pulsing with light as if breathing.
She actually found one?!
I can feel an immense surge of mana. It wasn't there a moment ago...
Why does this feel so familiar, nyaa?
It doesn't seem evil.
It actually feels warm and inviting...
This must be the extraordinary mahjong tile.
Ms. Frieren, Ms. Ichihime, are these fog-like tethers around the tile a seal?
Hm... Hard to say.
Feels more like a protective barrier, nyaa.
Something is wrong. The magical balance maintaining this place has been shattered...
Argh?! What did you do, you phony fortune teller?!
Stay sharp, everyone! Prepare for battle!
Gurgle...
Just as Leia warned, eerie growls echo through the ruins.
Nyaaaa?! The monsters are swarming us like seagulls on a dropped sandwich, nyaa!
Master, what do we do, nyaa?
Grab the giant tile!
Sever those fog tethers!
Alright... Here I go!
Ms. Frieren, everyone, please lend us your strength!
However, with monsters closing in from all sides, we find no easy way to break through.
I can't slice through these tethers no matter what I try...
Physical attacks aren't working either!
The monsters are multiplying. We need to finish this quickly.
...But how do we cut them?
You're all overthinking this.
<color=#70946E>Reelseiden!</color>
Monster
Grrrgh...!
Huh?
In an instant, the fog tethers are sliced clean through. The monsters, which had been fiercely guarding the giant tile, suddenly lose their will to fight.
Sunlight streams down from the clearing skies as the fog nearby vanishes without a trace.
It seems it's all over...
I knew following those little monsters would lead to something fun!
She just cut right through them so effortlessly...
Who are you?
Übel
Allow me to introduce myself. I'm Übel, a mage.
You're a mage, too?
That's right.
Nyaaa... Judging by her aura, she must be the fourth visitor the Shrine detected, nyaa!
I see. So the fourth one is Übel.
Hm... So you ended up in this world as well?
Thanks for the help, Übel.
It was nothing.
By the way, I'm quite curious... What exactly is this clear block?
Yeah, we fought tooth and nail to get our hands on it, nyaa.
Let me take a look...
While she examines it, let's head back to camp and resupply.
Once everything is sorted, we can return.
Some time passes...
Oh! So it conceals a formula like this inside.
I should take ten years or so to study it thoroughly.
Absolutely not.
Whoa, hold on, that's way too long...
Ms. Frieren, shouldn't we return to camp first? At least to report our findings to Ms. Leia and the others.
But the lingering mana traces around here seem worth studying too. I'd like to stay a bit longer...
Still, Fern is right. We can't stay here forever. Let's head back to camp first.
Either way, light at the end of the tunnel at last, nyaa! Hurrah for us, nyaa!
Once the fog finally lifts, we should offer this tile at the Shrine as a souvenir of our adventure, nyaa!
Don't celebrate just yet.
Nyaa-nyaa?! What is that creepy noise, nyaa...?
As she speaks, the calm monsters suddenly grow restless once more.
Squishy Slime
Gurgle...
Man-Eating Mimic
Snap...
Stranger still, instead of attacking, they scatter in sheer panic.
The ground and walls tremble as if struck by an earthquake.
This level of shaking... Oh crap!
Watch out! The place is coming down!
Everyone, run!
We can't leave the tile behind after all our hard work, nyaa!
No... Absolutely not.
You won't take... my Sacred Tile!
But Ms. Frieren, Mikheit has already shown that every chest here is a mimic.
As we press on through the island's ruins, the truth behind the fog feels ever closer.
It's eating me, nyaa!
Don't worry, nyaa! My gut tells me this magic is going to save the day, nyaa!
Who knows? Maybe the monsters are gathering again.
